name: NGC 4921 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4921, an anemic spiral galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4921orient2525-hubble
story: One of the rare spirals in the Coma Galaxy Cluster, NGC 4921 has let its star formation dim, keeping a delicate swirl of dust in a ring around it. Hubble watched it for Cepheid variable stars, to measure the distance to Coma.

claims.text: NGC 4921 is one of the rare spirals in Coma, an anemic spiral
Its star formation is much less intense than usual
A delicate swirl of dust in a ring around the galaxy
The Coma Galaxy Cluster is also known as Abell 1656
NGC 4921 is a luminous spiral in the Coma cluster; the program phases Cepheid variables in it for a Cepheid distance to Coma
